text: Ophthalmology is a clinical medical discipline that studies the diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases of the visual organs (eyeballs, ocular appendages and related nervous systems). The course takes "precise visual protection" as its core, focusing on the microscopic anatomy of the eyeball, the physiological mechanism of vision, and the management of ophthalmic emergencies. It aims to cultivate students' mastery of the collection of ophthalmic disease history, specialized examinations (such as fundus photography and refraction), and drug/surgical treatment strategies. Have the clinical ability to independently handle common ophthalmic diseases (such as cataracts and glaucoma) and participate in the diagnosis and treatment of complex eye diseases (such as macular degeneration and optic neuropathy).
